inputs.text: This is yet another glaring sign that government institutions pushing handouts and redistribution to supposedly fix inequality are crumbling under their own corruption and incompetence. South African actress Terry Pheto is now tied to alleged financial misconduct with the National Lotteries Commission over R20.56 million in this SIU probe, with new details presented in the briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. These scandals show public money being siphoned off by insiders rather than serving any legitimate purpose, breeding corruption and dependency instead of the social order and self-reliance that built strong nations. Progressive schemes like this trample personal responsibility and traditional family values, weakening the authority that once kept communities stable. We must scrap this failed approach entirely and refocus on national strength, family, and individual accountability instead of propping up these bloated, wasteful authorities.
